sections.heading: DSNG.JK — Dharma Satya Nusantara
sections.markdown:
**Signal / why now:** #2 INDO NEGLECTED (12m −24.8%, 6m +7.1%, −26.6% off the 52-week high, Rp1,310, plantation / CPO factor). The screen fires on the neglect sleeve only. It is not on the MOMENTUM list.

**Discarded at the kill ledger, not re-underwritten.** DSNG has two judged kills: T-INDO-DSNG-001 (2026-07-13, valuation, at Rp1,180) and T-INDO-DSNG-002 (2026-08-19, liquidity, at Rp1,360). LESSON-0002 names DSNG a repeat-kill pair. The price is now Rp1,310, which is above the first kill (Rp1,180), so the prior entry math is not cheaper. Nothing new has changed the kill basis. Re-carding it would re-litigate two kills without new evidence.

**Fast-disqualify:** back-of-envelope EV at base rate is not the binding test here. The valuation-anchored target and the liquidity gate both failed in the two prior judgments and nothing in this session's screen clears either. "No" on the repeat-kill basis → DISCARD.

**Revisit trigger:** a fresh valuation at or below the Rp1,180 kill basis, plus an answer to the liquidity objection. Either one reopens the card.
